frozen_design.extraction_discipline: bounded O(1) accumulators per hour; NO per-trade retention; NO data-derived percentiles/quantiles; the V16 954.8 MiB peak came from per-day list retention (sizes/gaps/side lists) - that state class is FORBIDDEN here; time-ascending enforced (>100 regressions aborts with FAILED heavy-lock release carrying stderr tail)

bounded_scalars: sum_squared_log_ret(12dp, within-hour consecutive kept-row moves; the move into an hour's first row belongs to no hour)
entry_gap_s(6dp, gap from the previous KEPT row to this hour's first row)
run_state: max_run_buy / max_run_sell (max over the hour's rows of the GLOBAL run length ending at that row - cross-hour carry is part of the definition)
identities_and_semantics: qty in aggTrades is always > 0, so sum|qty| == sum qty == qty_total - one column, identity noted (draft's sum_abs_qty/sum_qty collapsed; disclosed refinement)
a zero-trade hour emits NO row (absent, not fabricated zeros); completeness is asserted as hourly_rows == 365x24 per symbol in the manifest (draft's 'emit zero rows' wording refined; disclosed)
buy aggressor polarity identical to V16: is_buyer_maker=false => buyer is the taker => BUY

daily_derive: group H1 rows by day_utc in order; additive fields summed; flow_imbalance=(B-S)/(B+S); vwap=sum(quote_total)/sum(qty_total); high/low over traded rows; last_price=last row's last_price; avg_trade_size=qty/n; interarrival_mean_s=(sum gap_sum_s + same-day entry_gap_s)/(gap_count + same-day entry gaps) - cross-midnight entry gaps belong to no day, exactly V16's within-day consecutive-kept-pair semantics; first/last_ts_ms = first/last rows'

reconciliation.purpose: MANDATORY P0 self-audit (owner mandate): daily derived from H1 must reconcile against V16's sha-pinned daily panel; mismatch beyond frozen tolerance = P0 blocker (BLOCKED_DATA)
reconciliation.tolerance_basis: v2: per-field max(measured v1 smoke noise, analytic N*ulp bias bound for BTC-scale days) with >= 10x headroom: total_qty 1.4e-5 measured / 2.4e-5 BTC bias bound -> 1e-3; total_notional 0.04 measured / ~6.1 BTC bias bound -> 25.0; vwap 2e-8 measured / 3e-5 BTC bound -> abs 1e-3 + rel 1e-9 (non-binding, 1.2e-4); flow_imbalance 5e-9 -> 1e-7; avg_trade_size 4.9e-9 -> 5e-8; interarrival_mean_s 4.2e-5 -> 1e-3; exact fields (counts/timestamps/prices) passed EXACTLY in v1 and stay exact
reconciliation.exclusion_note: the 8 statistical fields are exactly the retention/percentile class the V17 contract forbids at H1 (V16 computed them from per-day lists - the source of its 954.8 MiB RSS); their absence from H1 is the design working, not a gap

frozen_ceilings_breach_is_blocked_data.heavy_phases: every download/extraction under the round-2 machine-wide heavy lock (~/.my-quantitative-governance/heavy_runtime); FAILED releases MUST carry the stderr tail in the release note
